themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and techniques where AI assists developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process and user research workflows.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI to automate, enhance, or analyze user interface and usability testing.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers AI applications that support product managers in areas like roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, hiring, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations, biases, and privacy risks associated with AI in research and design.

themes.name: AI assisted recruitment
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and strategies that streamline and improve the recruitment process.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
